text:
Lina - Sales: Oliver's POC is blocked, streaming requests fail intermittently behind their corp proxy. Can we triage?
Devon - DevEx: Can you confirm SDK/lang + exact symptom? TS or Python?
Oliver - Customer: TS SDK v1.5.0. Stream starts then client stops receiving tokens after ~12s; app reports socket timeout. Proxy returns a 502 occasionally.
Ravi - Eng: Classic proxy buffering / idle timeout. Does the request use Transfer-Encoding: chunked?
Oliver - Customer: Yes, chunked. We can't change env vars (HTTP_PROXY enforced).
Maya - Support: Two pragmatic workarounds: 1) switch to short-polling (non-stream) for initial POC, 2) emit keepalive chunks from client to avoid idle.
Lina - Sales: Customer prefers no infra changes. They want a code workaround if possible.
Devon - DevEx: In TS SDK you can enable manual keepalives. Example snippet to send a tiny whitespace chunk every 3s while waiting:
```
// pseudo-TS: manual chunk heartbeat
const stream = await client.responses.stream(req);
const writer = stream.getWriter?.() || stream; // depends on API
setInterval(() => {
  try { writer.write(' '); } catch (e) {}
}, 3000);
```
Maya - Support: Alternative is to reduce server idle time by forcing smaller batches from model (max_tokens low) so tokens arrive more frequently. Also set client socket timeout shorter to fail fast and retry via a backoff.
Ravi - Eng: We'll prototype two things: heartbeat and server-side micro-batches. If heartbeat works against an nginx proxy emulation, we'll publish a short runbook.
Oliver - Customer: If heartbeat requires SDK internals, will you share a supported pattern? We can't patch our app too much.
Devon - DevEx: We can provide a small helper wrapper (3 lines) that uses existing SDK streaming API; no deep changes. Also mention Node agent keepAlive: set https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 10000 }) to prevent socket churn.
Lina - Sales: Budget question: if we offer a temporary Dedicated POC endpoint to bypass their proxy, what's the process?
Ravi - Eng: That's sales-managed. Ops can spin a short-lived dedicated host with different egress. infra-bot, can you provision a poc-dedicated for this customer?
infra-bot: Provision request received. Creating dedicated-poc-173990 for trial in us-east-1. ETA ~10m.
Maya - Support: While infra spins up, try this TS test to emulate keepalive to proxy via curl/nc:
```
printf 'POST /stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n3\r\n{}\r\n1\r\n \r\n0\r\n\r\n' | nc proxy.example 8080
```
Ravi - Eng: Note: Some proxies buffer chunked bodies until the final 0 chunk. Heartbeat works if proxy passes through chunks; otherwise need the dedicated route.
Oliver - Customer: infra approved temporary endpoint. Please send instructions.
Devon - DevEx: Quick TS config to try once endpoint is live:
```
client.setBaseUrl('https://dedicated-poc-173990.redwood.ai');
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 15000 });
await client.responses.stream(req, { fetchOptions: { agent, timeout: 25000 } });
```
Lina - Sales: I'll email procurement the one-week Dedicated POC quote. Oliver, will share PO if they accept.
Maya - Support: Action list: Ravi to test heartbeat vs nginx proxy locally; Devon to produce a 1-pager with TS + Python snippets; Lina to handle dedicated POC quote; I'll monitor once customer attaches.
Ravi - Eng: Quick update: local nginx reproduced 15s idle drop. Heartbeat at 3s prevented drop. Will post the minimal patch shortly.
Oliver - Customer: Thanks team — appreciate the quick swarm.
Lina - Sales: Reconnect tomorrow after dedicated POC is provisioned. :thumbsup:
